name: PyCub Development Environment
postStartCommand: setsid bash -c 'export DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-:1} DISPLAY_NUM=${DISPLAY_NUM:-1}; rm -f /tmp/.X${DISPLAY_NUM}-lock; Xvfb ${DISPLAY} -screen 0 1920x1080x24 +extension GLX +render -noreset >/tmp/xvfb.log 2>&1 & sleep 2; startxfce4 >/tmp/xfce.log 2>&1 & x11vnc -display ${DISPLAY} -N -forever -shared -bg -noxdamage >/tmp/x11vnc.log 2>&1 & /opt/novnc/utils/novnc_proxy --web /opt/novnc --vnc localhost:59${DISPLAY_NUM} --listen 6080 >/dev/null 2>&1 &' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 3
